I've checked both items from order TR-4522. 

For your **Everyday Cotton Tee**, it's well inside our 30-day return window, so I've gone ahead and raised the return for a refund. You'll get a text shortly to schedule a free reverse pickup. Once it reaches our warehouse and passes inspection, your refund will be processed back to your card in 5–7 business days.

As for the **Ankle Socks 3-pack**, unfortunately, innerwear is a non-returnable category for hygiene and safety reasons, so we aren't able to accept those back. 

Let me know if you need help with anything else!
